summary: Iteration 47 regression: (1) Backend — auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/stats, /api/leaderboard, /api/events?archived=false, /api/members?search=admin, push (vapid-public-key/history/templates/broadcast), point-calc (list/create/get/delete/export). All 13 tests PASSED. (2) Frontend — full Widget Grubu (widget grouping) flow on /gosterge-paneli verified: 4 default widgets render, group-mode toggle → hint, 2-widget selection → overlays, 'Grupla (2)' creates group container with orange dashed border, localStorage titanxis_widget_groups_v1 persists {id,color,name,widgets}. Rename to 'Kritik KPI' via Enter works and persists. Color picker opens with 7 swatches; blue #38BDF8 applied and persists. 'Grubu Çöz' ungroups (widgets remain, groups=[]). Theme strip vivid/minimal/mono all switch and persist to titanxis_widget_theme_v1. Widget size cycle normal→wide→compact→normal persists to titanxis_widget_sizes_v1. Widget Library at /widget-kitapligi (NOT /widgetler) shows all 12 widget cards, search filter narrows to 5 for query 'Top', 'Etkinlik' category filter narrows to 2 cards, all 12 wglib-toggle-* buttons and 48 wglib-size-* buttons present.
action_items: Review request referred to Widget Library route as /widgetler, but the actual route is /widget-kitapligi (defined in /app/frontend/src/App.js:87). Either update the review request/docs, or add /widgetler as an alias if the shorter route is desired for UX consistency with /gosterge-paneli.

Review request referred to point-calc endpoints as GET/POST /api/point-calc (no query) and GET /api/point-calc/export/all — actual API requires ?kind=pre|diger query param and export path is /api/point-calc/export?kind=... . Tests updated to match implementation; docs should be aligned.
critical_code_review_comments: WidgetGrid.jsx is 1005 lines — consider splitting into subcomponents (GroupHeader, GroupPalette, WidgetCard, ThemeStrip) to bring below the ~700 LOC guideline. Grouping logic could live in a small useWidgetGroups hook.
Group IDs use Date.now()+random suffix client-side (g_<ms>_<rnd>) — fine for local persistence but if groups ever sync to backend a UUID would be safer.
widget-group-name click-to-edit UX is good and IDs are stable, but the color-picker palette closes only on outside click (verified) — consider Esc key to close for a11y.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for widget grouping + theme + size + library
